nodes.name: Hydrothermal Synthesis of NiFe LDH
nodes.procedure: Iron-doped micro flower like Ni-layered double hydroxide (Ni(1-x)Fex LDH) on Ni foam synthesized through hydrothermal method. The formation of flower-like morphology arises from the slow dissociation and diffusion rate of precipitating anions during the urea hydrolysis process in the reaction mixture.

unit_operations.name: Urea Hydrolysis
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: slow dissociation and diffusion rate of precipitating anions during the urea hydrolysis process

nodes.source_text: Rajeshkhanna et al. reported a cheaper, stable, very active and eco-friendly iron-doped micro flower like Ni-layered double hydroxide (Ni1-xFex LDH) on Ni foam synthesized through hydrothermal method.

nodes.name: Sulfurization
nodes.procedure: FeNiS nanoflower electrocatalyst synthesized by the sulfurization of FeNiO supported on a Ni foam (NF) by a facile hydrothermal method.
nodes.source_text: A similar kind of nanoflower-shaped FeNiS electrocatalyst, synthesized by the sulfurization of FeNiO supported on a Ni foam (NF) by a facile hydrothermal method was reported in the literature.
